title: 第13章 无上异宝初现世林镜随口散劫雷第14章 通天教主忆往昔林镜盘算下一宝
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
林镜看着手中的多宝塔，随即眼眸中出现了几道选择！
【检测到先天灵宝多宝塔，可选择消耗500灵宝积分强化此宝，可让其进化为极品先天灵宝，增加修复先天灵宝功效！】
才区区极品先天灵宝吗？感觉有些不太够啊，林镜心想！
然而懂事的灵宝系统，顿时心领神会再次显示道：
【可选择消耗2000灵宝积分进行强化，可让其进化为天道无上异宝，增加孕育灵宝功效，并且可以定制灵宝属性及效果！】
林镜看了看，现在只剩下了2000
积分了，不过还是果断梭哈了进去！
手中的多宝塔也直接纳入体内，进行强化！
而一旁的多宝道人却不慌不忙，丝毫不担心自己的至宝丢失！
早在前来寻宝的路上，林镜就将和通天教主的说辞和多宝也说了一遍！
当时的多宝道人也没有过多询问，毕竟强化先天灵宝这种匪夷所思的能力肯定要付出极大的代价！
现在林镜主动要求，多宝也就顺水推舟拿了出来！
“师弟，我们还是先回金鳌岛吧！现在已经和阐教金仙沾染了因果，还是和老师禀报一番最好！”
林镜闻言点了点头，按照阐教那群人的性格，说不定现在已经快马加鞭跑回昆仑山诉苦去了，肯定少不了添油加醋一番！
这要是让元始天尊觉得丢了面皮，那他们这点实力恐怕在圣人一个念头之下就化为灰烬了！
还好此地距离金鳌岛也就半天的行程，若是多宝道人全力催动法宝的话，用不了多久就回去了！
多宝道人也的确不敢耽误，他们这几天的所作所为以及林镜手上的九九散魄葫芦，都是压力啊！
终于在快要回到金鳌岛之时，多宝道人才松了口气！
这时，林镜也看到了系统的提示！
【叮！天道无上异宝多宝塔强化完毕！】

林镜这时也拉住了多宝道人笑着说道：
“师兄，我这点微末本领也算不得什么，还望师兄不要嫌弃！”
多宝道人还以为是林镜强化多宝塔失败了，还大度的安慰道：
“没事，多宝塔作为先天灵宝，其能力已经足够强大了，就算不能达到极品先天也是正常的！”
林镜明白多宝师兄误会了，也没有解释，直接将多宝塔取了出来！
多宝道人一边随手接过多宝塔一边还在安慰道：
“灵宝之道十分复杂，蕴含三千大道并且互相交融，师弟你现在修为还浅，不宜研究太深！”
原本多宝还准备再教育林镜几句，然而还没有来得及说出口，异变突生！
原本万里无云、湛蓝如洗的天空，转瞬间被厚重的乌云覆盖，整个天地间弥漫起一种压抑而肃穆的气氛。
而在那层层叠叠的黑云深处，一道道紫色的劫雷穿梭其间，以惊人的速度交织缠绕，逐渐汇聚成一个庞大的旋涡。
旋涡的正中心，正是截教的大师兄多宝道人，此刻的他一脸懵逼的看着周围发生的变化，完全不明白到底发生了什么？
难道是元始天尊直接出手了，想要召唤劫雷将他灭杀？
可是圣人如果真的出手，那还需要这么麻烦呢？
可是这漫天的劫雷做不得假啊？看样子还是最高规格的紫霄神雷！
他前不久才刚刚斩却二尸，度过天劫，就算修炼再快也不至于现在就迎来天劫啊？
当他环顾四周，发现林镜还在一旁站着，饶有兴趣的看着上方的天劫，赶紧训斥道：
“师弟，快走，这天劫是冲我来的！”
林镜笑而不语，他没想到一件天道无上异宝的出世竟然会引起天道如此剧烈的反应，看来这天道也不喜欢自己预料之外的事情发生啊！
眼见林镜纹丝不动，多宝道人急了，这劫雷他扛下去最多重伤而已！
师弟这小身板，恐怕一道紫霄神雷都扛不住吧！

正当多宝道人准备施展法术，将林镜安全转移，远离即将到来的劫雷旋涡之时，一抹奇异的光芒吸引了他的注意力。
content_en:
Lin Jing looked at the Duobao Pagoda in his hand, and then several choices appeared in his eyes!
[When a tower of innate spiritual treasures is detected, you can choose to spend 500 spiritual treasure points to strengthen this treasure, which can evolve into the best innate spiritual treasure and increase the effect of repairing the innate spiritual treasure! 】
Is this just the best innate spiritual treasure? It feels a little not enough, Lin Jing thought to himself!
However, the sensible Lingbao System suddenly understood and showed again:
[You can choose to spend 2,000 Lingbao points to strengthen it, which can evolve it into the supreme treasure of heaven, increase the effect of nurturing Lingbao, and customize the attributes and effects of Lingbao! 】
Lin Jing took a look and found that there were only 2000 left.
I lost points, but I still decided to enter!
The multi-treasure tower in your hand is also directly incorporated into the body for strengthening!
But Taoist Duobao on the side was not in a hurry, not worried at all about losing his treasure!
On the way to the treasure hunt, Lin Jing had already told Duobao what he had said to the Tongtian leader!
At that time, Taoist Duobao didn't ask too much. After all, strengthening the incredible ability of the innate spiritual treasure must have a huge price!
Now that Lin Jing took the initiative to request it, Duobao just took it out!
"Junior brother, let's go back to Jin'ao Island first! Now that we have been involved in the cause and effect of Jinxian Chan, it's best to report it to the teacher!"
Lin Jing nodded when he heard this. According to the character of Chanjiao's group of people, they might have rushed back to Kunlun Mountain to complain, and they would definitely add fuel to the fire!
If this makes Yuanshi Tianzun feel that he has lost his face, then their little strength may be reduced to ashes with just one thought from the saint!
Fortunately, this place is only half a day's journey from Jin'ao Island. If Taoist Duobao uses all his strength to activate the magic weapon, it won't take long for him to go back!
Taoist Duobao really didn't dare to delay. What they had done in the past few days and the Jiujiu Soul Gourd in Lin Jing's hand were all pressure!
Finally, when he was about to return to Jin'ao Island, Taoist Duobao breathed a sigh of relief!
At this time, Lin Jing also saw the system prompt!
【bite! The Supreme Treasure Tower of Heaven has been strengthened! 】
At this time, Lin Jing also grabbed Taoist Duobao and said with a smile:
"Senior brother, my little ability is nothing. I hope senior brother won't dislike it!"
Taoist Duobao thought that Lin Jing had failed to strengthen the Duobao Pagoda, and generously consoled him:
"It's okay. As an innate spiritual treasure, Duobao Pagoda's ability is already powerful enough. Even if it doesn't reach the highest level of innateness, it's normal!"
Lin Jing understood that Senior Brother Duobao had misunderstood, and took out the Duobao Pagoda without any explanation!
Taoist Duobao took the Duobao Pagoda casually and comforted him:
"The Tao of Lingbao is very complicated. It contains three thousand avenues and are intertwined with each other. Junior brother, your cultivation is still shallow now, so it is not appropriate to study too deeply!"
Originally, Duobao was planning to educate Lin Jing a few more words, but before he could say anything, something unexpected happened!
The originally cloudless, blue sky was suddenly covered by thick dark clouds, and a depressing and solemn atmosphere filled the entire world.
And deep in the layers of black clouds, purple thunderbolts shuttled through them, intertwining and entangled at an astonishing speed, and gradually gathered into a huge vortex.
At the very center of the vortex was Taoist Duobao, the senior brother of Jiejiao. At this moment, he was looking at the changes happening around him with a confused look on his face. He had no idea what was going on.
Could it be that Yuanshi Tianzun took action directly and wanted to summon the tribulation thunder to kill him?
But if the saint really takes action, why does he need to go to such trouble?
But this thunderstorm that fills the sky cannot be faked? It seems that it is still the highest standard Zixiao Divine Thunder!
He had just killed two corpses and survived the catastrophe not long ago. No matter how fast he practiced, he wouldn't be facing the catastrophe now?
When he looked around, he found that Lin Jing was still standing aside, looking at the Heavenly Tribulation above with interest, and quickly reprimanded:
"Junior brother, leave quickly, this disaster is coming for me! "
Lin Jing smiled and said nothing. He did not expect that the birth of a supreme treasure of Heaven would cause such a violent reaction from Heaven. It seems that Heaven does not like things that he did not expect to happen!
Seeing that Lin Jing was not moving at all, Taoist Duobao became anxious. He would only be seriously injured if he could bear this calamity thunder!
Junior brother, with his small body, I'm afraid he can't even bear a purple sky thunder!
Just as Taoist Duobao was about to cast a spell to safely transfer Lin Jing away from the coming thunder whirlpool, a strange light attracted his attention.
